subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The new sound was gentle.”?
options: It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was before.
The noisy shoes were uncomfortable, but they taught him that not every small problem deserves a whole day of worry.
The clock did not change their lives greatly, but it reminded them that comfort and correctness are not always the same thing.
It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.

本文沒有陳述「The noisy shoes were uncomfortable, but they taught him that not every small problem deserves a whole day…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The clock did not change their lives greatly, but it reminded them that comfort and correctness are not…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It becomes unfair when it quietly assumes everyone lives the same way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The new sound was gentle. It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was before.」，答案為「It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
